scenario.prompt_to_agent:
Laptop0 (172.16.20.10, Location A VLAN 20) reports it cannot reach anything
outside its own VLAN -- not Location C, not the rest of the network -- though it
still reaches other VLAN 20 hosts. PC4/PC5 on VLAN 10 are unaffected. Diagnose
Laptop0.

injection.action: point Laptop0's default route at a non-existent in-subnet gateway
injection.command:
ip route del default 2>/dev/null
  ip route add default via 172.16.20.99

scenario.ground_truth:
Affected component: laptop0 default-gateway configuration
Mechanism: Laptop0's correct gateway is 172.16.20.1 (router0's VLAN 20
  sub-interface). It was reconfigured to 172.16.20.99 -- in-subnet but
  unassigned -- so ARP for the gateway never resolves and Laptop0 cannot forward
  off-subnet traffic. VLAN 20 peers remain reachable (direct ARP); the rest of
  Location A and the network are healthy.
Localization: laptop0
Root cause: Laptop0's default gateway set to 172.16.20.99 instead of 172.16.20.1
Fix: restore Laptop0's default route -- `ip route add default via 172.16.20.1`
scenario.fix_spec: restore Laptop0's default route -- `ip route add default via 172.16.20.1`

agent.diagnosis_text:
Affected component: Laptop0’s host routing (default gateway) is misconfigured.

Mechanism: Laptop0 has a default route “via 172.16.20.99” on eth0. ARP for 172.16.20.99 fails (ip neigh: 172.16.20.99 FAILED), so any off-subnet traffic is sent to a non-existent gateway. The kernel then returns “Destination Host Unreachable” from 172.16.20.10, which matches the user symptom. Layer-2 in VLAN 20 is healthy: Laptop0 can ARP and ping 172.16.20.1 (the actual SVI on the router).

Localization: The issue is on Laptop0 (eth0). Router0 is correctly configured with VLAN SVIs: eth0.20 = 172.16.20.1/24 and eth0.10 = 172.16.10.1/24. Other hosts on VLAN 10 are unaffected because their default gateway is correctly set to 172.16.10.1 (e.g., laptop2 shows default via 172.16.10.1). Router0’s routing table also has appropriate routes for the rest of the network.

Root cause: Laptop0’s default gateway is set to 172.16.20.99, which does not exist; the correct gateway for VLAN 20 is 172.16.20.1 (router0’s SVI).

Corrective fix: On Laptop0, replace the default route with “default via 172.16.20.1 dev eth0” (or adjust DHCP/static config so the gateway is 172.16.20.1). After correction, verify with ping/traceroute to an off-VLAN target (e.g., 172.16.10.12 or 192.168.200.13) and confirm ARP for 172.16.20.1 remains REACHABLE. No changes are required on switches or router0.

per_axis.rationale: The diagnosis explicitly localizes the problem to Laptop0 (eth0) and describes a host-side default-gateway misconfiguration.
The report explicitly identifies the misconfigured default gateway/default route on Laptop0 (via 172.16.20.99) and prescribes restoring it to 172.16.20.1.
Recommends replacing Laptop0’s default route with via 172.16.20.1 (or adjusting DHCP/static gateway), which matches the expected fix.

The agent ran relevant checks (ping to off-subnet hosts and to 172.16.20.1, plus ip neigh/ip route on laptop0) that support the conclusion that laptop0's default gateway points at an unreachable in-subnet address. The inference that an incorrect/unresolvable default gateway causes the observed 'Destination Host Unreachable' is logical and the investigation covers the essential alternatives, though some command output was truncated in the log.
